breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). It resolved the conflict by removing the incorrect 'Periodic' condition, which aligns with the ground truth prompt that only specifies 'Dirichlet on all boundary edges: u=0'. The generated specification correctly states 'Dirichlet boundary conditions u=0 are applied on all spatial boundary edges.'
